run_wasm_server: run the WASM TCP server on localhost port 8888 in a background thread
query_device: query device information from a connected IoT device via its TCP socket connection
install_wasm_applet: install a WASM applet file onto a connected IoT device by name and file path
uninstall_wasm_applet: uninstall a named WASM applet from a connected IoT device via its TCP socket
decode_attr_container: decode a binary attribute container message into a Python dictionary of key-value pairs
